verification_notes: Cheddar Fries has two printed prices: ₹100 on the black menu page and ₹120 on the white menu page. The JSON uses ₹100 as the primary value and preserves ₹120 as an alternative.
Virgin Mojito has two printed prices: ₹89 on the black drinks page and ₹80 on the white menu page. The JSON uses ₹89 as the primary value and preserves ₹80 as an alternative.
Boost Boba has two printed prices: ₹120 on the black drinks page and ₹140 on the white menu page. The JSON uses ₹120 as the primary value and preserves ₹140 as an alternative.
The white menu page lists additional Boba flavours; these have been included with their printed prices.

The white menu page shows a general Burger list with Smashed Beef Burger ₹220, XL ₹290, XXL ₹350; Smashed Chicken Burger ₹170, XL ₹260, XXL ₹320; Zinger Burger ₹150; and Veg Burger ₹120. The Classic Wrap page separately lists Triple Treat Burger ₹250.
Combo ingredient wording follows the printed menu. Some combo descriptions use shortened names such as 'cheese loaded' and 'beef loaded'; confirm exact variants with the cafe before publishing.
The first combo-menu photograph is partly cropped. The later, clearer combo-menu photographs were used for the full combo prices and descriptions.
